title: Your Free artistname.digitvl.com Merch Store
desc: Every DIGITVL store gets its own free address, yourname.digitvl.com. Your own domain is optional.

sentences.text: Your fans can find you at artistname.digitvl.com
No website builder to learn. No hosting to set up.
Pick your name when you sign up, and the address is yours.
Want your own domain? That's optional. Request it and connect it to the same store.
Put the link in your bio, your videos, your tour posters.
One link. Your whole merch shop.
